zh: 设置页的开关原来按下后圆钮匀速滑到另一端。现在圆钮越过终点再弹回（约 0.35 秒）；只有按过的开关才这样动，打开设置页或换回某个分页时，各个开关都静止在原位。
en: A settings switch used to slide its knob straight across. The knob now runs past the end and settles back (about 0.35 s); only a switch the reader has pressed moves like this, and opening the page or coming back to a tab shows every switch at rest.
